intro.text: A kind of greatshell that can grow as tall as a building and looks somewhat like a slug.
A slug-like greatshell, as tall as a building when fully grown, that lives on the beaches and coastal shallows of Roshar, especially around Aimia.

description.text: Beneath its carapace, a yu-thorak is pinkish white.
The Sleepless seem able to control them, and use them to guard Aimia against unwanted visitors.
